clips.caption:
Bilderberg. Bohemian Grove. Skull and Bones. The Brotherhood.

Kevin says the real plan isn't guessed at by a podcast host reading headlines - it's discussed inside those rooms, and he was one of the people in them. Not a theory, his words: "this is what it is."

And the plan, on the surface, sounds almost noble: end starvation, end the billion people going to bed hungry, lift the parts of the world with no electricity and no hospital nearby.

That's the pitch. What it actually requires is where it gets uncomfortable.
